title: lidar-terrain-arcgis-tools: ArcGIS Pro toolbox for LiDAR-derived topographic factors
description: An ArcGIS Pro Python toolbox that derives topographic factors from DGT LiDAR elevation data (DEM and DSM) in batch, per area of interest: per area and per cluster mosaics, slope, aspect, hillshade and curvature, annual solar radiation (GPU RasterSolarRadiation), reclassification of aspect, slope and solar into suitability classes, and resampling. Project CRS EPSG:3763 (ETRS89 / PT-TM06).
